searchText: Can anyone explain security implications of this issue to Eth2 PoS? https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-bls-signature/issues/38 Though this PR is merged into irtf draft, it doesn't yet seem to be implemented in blst 0.3.3 (it follows irtf draft v4), which is used by lighthouse client 3.4.0 by default: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/38514c07f222ff7783834c48cf5c0a6ee7f346d0/crypto/bls/Cargo.toml#L23 Am i misunderstanding anything? Lighthouse actually uses blst 0.3.10 in v3.4.0: <https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/38514c07f222ff7783834c48cf5c0a6ee7f346d0/Cargo.lock#L769-L770> the 0.3.10 is semver compatible with the 0.3.3 dependency spec, so it got upgraded to automatically as for the vuln, I think we already deal with this in our usage of `FastAggregateVerify` at the spec level, although it's been a while since I looked in detail Oh right forgot the fact that it's semver, but still I don't think 0.3.10 have that suggested fix implemented?

excerpts.author: owl4219
excerpts.content:
Can anyone explain security implications of this issue to Eth2 PoS? https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-bls-signature/issues/38 
Though this PR is merged into irtf draft, it doesn't yet seem to be implemented in blst 0.3.3 (it follows irtf draft v4), which is used by lighthouse client 3.4.0 by default: https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/38514c07f222ff7783834c48cf5c0a6ee7f346d0/crypto/bls/Cargo.toml#L23
Am i misunderstanding anything?

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
Lighthouse actually uses blst 0.3.10 in v3.4.0: <https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/blob/38514c07f222ff7783834c48cf5c0a6ee7f346d0/Cargo.lock#L769-L770>

the 0.3.10 is semver compatible with the 0.3.3 dependency spec, so it got upgraded to automatically

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content: as for the vuln, I think we already deal with this in our usage of `FastAggregateVerify` at the spec level, although it's been a while since I looked in detail

excerpts.content: Oh right forgot the fact that it's semver, but still I don't think 0.3.10 have that suggested fix implemented?
